functions.name: central
functions.description: Federated Cox proportional hazards algorithm (Breslow ties) for Vantage6 v4

arguments.name: time_col
arguments.description: Name of the column containing the time-to-event data.

arguments.name: outcome_col
arguments.description: Name of the column containing the event indicator (1=event, 0=censored).

arguments.name: expl_vars
arguments.description: List of explanatory variables to include in the model: plain column names, or single-entry mappings of a column name to a categorical spec (reference and categories) or a scored spec (scores, optional missing). A list of names stays valid.

arguments.name: organization_ids
arguments.description: List of organisation IDs to include. If None, all organisations are used.

arguments.name: covariate_profiles
arguments.description: Optional covariate profiles for survival curves: a list of objects mapping explanatory variable names to values. Variables left out are taken at the pooled event-case mean (the baseline profile).

functions.name: compute_summed_z
functions.description: Compute the sum of the explanatory variables over the event cases.

arguments.name: time_col
arguments.description: Name of the column containing the time data.

arguments.name: outcome_col
arguments.description: Name of the column containing the outcome data.

arguments.name: expl_vars
arguments.description: List of explanatory variables to include in the model: plain column names, or single-entry mappings of a column name to a categorical spec (reference and categories) or a scored spec (scores, optional missing). A list of names stays valid.

functions.name: perform_iteration
functions.description: Compute the per-event-time risk-set aggregates for one Newton-Raphson iteration.

arguments.name: time_col
arguments.description: Name of the column containing the time data.

arguments.name: outcome_col
arguments.description: Name of the column containing the outcome data.

arguments.name: expl_vars
arguments.description: List of explanatory variables to include in the model: plain column names, or single-entry mappings of a column name to a categorical spec (reference and categories) or a scored spec (scores, optional missing). A list of names stays valid.

arguments.name: beta
arguments.description: Current coefficient vector (one entry per explanatory variable).

arguments.name: centre
arguments.description: Pooled covariate means over the event cases (one entry per explanatory variable).

arguments.name: scale
arguments.description: Pooled covariate standard deviations over the event cases (one entry per explanatory variable).

arguments.name: unique_time_events
arguments.description: Sorted list of unique event times shared by the central function.
